The table below summarises the main variables used directly in the statistical analyses. Some categorical variables were collapsed into reduced analytical categories following the criteria described in the manuscript.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

metadata_table <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Variable, ~Description,

  "n_mixed_broods", "number of mixed-paternity broods",
  "n_non_mixed_broods", "number of non-mixed-paternity broods",
  "n_total_broods", "total number of broods",

  "Study_ID", "unique reference-level study identifier",
  "Clements_name", "species name used for phylogenetic matching following McTavish et al. 2025 ",
  "marker_type_model", "molecular marker classification",
  "nest_box_model", "nest-box versus natural nesting classification used in the analyses",
  "nest_type_model", "reduced BIRDBASE nest-type classification used in the analyses  following Şekercioğlu et al. (2025)",
  "breeding_system", "breeding-system classification following Brouwer and Griffith (2019)",
  "mono_poly_model", "BIRDBASE breeding-system classification",
  "parental_care", "parental-care classification following Cockburn (2006) and Griesser et al (2017) ",
  "cooperative_breeding", "classification of cooperative breeding status Co‐BreeD dtabase following McTavish et al. 2025",
  "migration", "migratory status classification from BIRDBASE",
  "coloniality", "colonial breeding classification from BIRDBASE",
  "CS_max", "maximum clutch size from BIRDBASE",
  "body_mass", "average adult body mass from BIRDBASE",
  "study_duration_num", "study duration in years",
  "latitude", "latitude of the study population",
  "longitude", "longitude of the study population"
)

knitr::kable(metadata_table)

```
